title: Why did the Pahalgam Terror Attack Happen in 2025?
description:
On April 22, 2025, serenity in Pahalgam, Kashmir was shattered by a brutal terror attack. Militants ambushed tourists in Baisaran Valley, killing 26 and injuring dozens. Survivors report that attackers demanded victims recite the Shahada (Kalima) before sparing them — those who couldn’t were executed. This massacre wasn’t random; it was claimed by The Resistance Front (TRF), a Lashkar-e-Taiba proxy, aiming to spread fear, disrupt peace, and fuel religious violence in Kashmir

In this documentary, Pale Blue Thoughts critically examines the Shahada — not just as a declaration of faith but as a political tool turned litmus test of life or death. We analyze verses like the Sword Verse (Quran 9:5) and other passages extremists use to justify violence, and explore the apocalyptic doctrine of Ghazwa-e-Hind, which envisions the conquest of India under Islamic rule. Groups like Jaish-e-Mohammed and Ansar Ghazwat-ul-Hind openly invoke this narrative, linking Kashmir terror with religious prophecy.

But beyond geopolitics, this is about ideology. The Shahada has been weaponized, turning belief into a password for survival. Apostates and dissenters — from ex-Muslims in India to global freethinkers — know the cost of questioning. When belief is enforced by fear, it ceases to be faith; it becomes control.

If you’ve searched for Pahalgam attack news, Kashmir terror 2025, Shahada explained, Ghazwa-e-Hind ideology, Lashkar-e-Taiba proxy TRF, or religious violence India, this video gives you the full picture — facts, history, and the dangerous psychology of faith turned into fanaticism.
